verdict.rationale: Decagon's docs show brand-voice consistency built into multiple surfaces: chat, voice (multilingual), and email are all described as 'on-brand', and AOPs let support leaders define agent behavior/tone in natural language like SOPs (docs-13,14,15,16). Testing/QA and Experiments explicitly validate tone/brand across pathways and let leaders 'refine tone' safely before and after deployment (docs-11,29,32). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence that tone actually stays consistent across many topics and languages in production, and no explicit mention of cross-language consistency for chat/email (only voice is called multilingual).
